(Search-snippet content — pollster headlines and figures, mid-July 2026)

YouGov voting intention, 12-13 July 2026 (for The Times and Sky News): Reform 24%, Con 19%,
Lab 19%, Grn 15%, Lib Dem 13%. Reform five points ahead. Earlier YouGov (5-6 July): Reform 25%,
Con 21%, Lab 20%, Grn 13%, LD 12%.

Survation (fieldwork 10-14 July 2026), final Westminster voting intention with Starmer as leader:
Labour and Reform tied on 24% each — "The draw comes after Reform led this series for more than a
year. Labour are also up five points compared to our 17th June poll, their largest single upward
movement since the 2024 General Election, while Reform are down three." Named-leader test: Labour
led by Andy Burnham 24%, Reform UK led by Nigel Farage 24%.
